english: Powered Melee Kills cause the target to release a pulse after 0.67 seconds, disorienting enemies within 9 meters for <pve 2.5 /> <pvp [4?] /> seconds.

source.text:
2 Piece | Augmented Servos

On Powered Melee Kill:
Target releases a Disorienting Pulse over 9 meters after 0.67 seconds of dying.
Disorienting Pulse inflicts Disorient for 2.5 [4?] seconds.
